reference: SELECT sid,sname FROM Sailors WHERE rating>=8
alternative: SELECT s.sid,s.sname FROM Sailors s WHERE NOT(s.rating<8)
wrong: SELECT sid,sname FROM Sailors WHERE rating>8

reference: SELECT sid,age FROM Sailors WHERE age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age,sid
alternative: SELECT s.sid,s.age FROM Sailors s WHERE s.age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2 ASC,1 ASC
wrong: SELECT sid,age FROM Sailors WHERE age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age DESC,sid

reference: SELECT DISTINCT r.sid FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE b.color='red'
alternative: SELECT s.sid FROM Sailors s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE r.sid=s.sid AND b.color='red')
wrong: SELECT r.sid FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE b.color='red'

reference: SELECT s.sid,COUNT(r.sid) FROM Sailors s LEFT JOIN Reserves r ON r.sid=s.sid GROUP BY s.sid
alternative: SELECT s.sid,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reserves r WHERE r.sid=s.sid) FROM Sailors s
wrong: SELECT s.sid,COUNT(*) FROM Sailors s LEFT JOIN Reserves r ON r.sid=s.sid GROUP BY s.sid

reference: SELECT rating,COUNT(*),AVG(age) FROM Sailors WHERE age>=18 GROUP BY rating HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
alternative: SELECT rating,n,a FROM (SELECT rating,COUNT(*) n,AVG(age) a FROM Sailors WHERE age>=18 GROUP BY rating) g WHERE n>=2
wrong: SELECT rating,COUNT(*),AVG(age) FROM Sailors WHERE age>18 GROUP BY rating HAVING COUNT(*)>=2

reference: SELECT sid,rating FROM Sailors WHERE rating=(SELECT MAX(rating) FROM Sailors)
alternative: SELECT s.sid,s.rating FROM Sailors s WHERE s.rating IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Sailors t WHERE t.rating>s.rating)
wrong: SELECT sid,rating FROM Sailors WHERE sid=(SELECT MIN(sid) FROM Sailors WHERE rating=(SELECT MAX(rating) FROM Sailors))

reference: SELECT s.sid,s.sname FROM Sailors s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Reserves r WHERE r.sid=s.sid)
alternative: SELECT s.sid,s.sname FROM Sailors s LEFT JOIN Reserves r ON r.sid=s.sid WHERE r.sid IS NULL
wrong: SELECT s.sid,s.sname FROM Sailors s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Reserves)

reference: WITH c AS (SELECT sid,COUNT(*) n FROM Reserves GROUP BY sid) SELECT sid,n FROM c WHERE n>=2
alternative: SELECT sid,COUNT(*) FROM Reserves GROUP BY sid HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
wrong: SELECT sid,COUNT(DISTINCT bid) FROM Reserves GROUP BY sid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bid)>=2

reference: SELECT r.sid FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE b.color='red' EXCEPT SELECT r.sid FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE b.color='green'
alternative: SELECT DISTINCT r.sid FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE b.color='red' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Reserves t JOIN Boats c ON c.bid=t.bid WHERE t.sid=r.sid AND c.color='green')
wrong: SELECT DISTINCT r.sid FROM Reserves r JOIN Boats b ON b.bid=r.bid WHERE b.color='red'

reference: SELECT ProductID,ProductName FROM products WHERE Discontinued=0 AND UnitPrice>20
alternative: SELECT p.ProductID,p.ProductName FROM products p WHERE NOT(p.Discontinued<>0) AND 20<p.UnitPrice
wrong: SELECT ProductID,ProductName FROM products WHERE Discontinued=0 AND UnitPrice>=20

reference: SELECT ProductID,UnitPrice FROM products WHERE UnitPrice IS NOT NULL ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC,ProductID ASC
alternative: SELECT p.ProductID,p.UnitPrice FROM products p WHERE p.UnitPrice IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2 DESC,1
wrong: SELECT ProductID,UnitPrice FROM products WHERE UnitPrice IS NOT NULL ORDER BY UnitPrice ASC,ProductID

reference: SELECT p.ProductID,p.ProductName,c.CategoryName FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID
alternative: SELECT p.ProductID,p.ProductName,c.CategoryName FROM products p,categories c WHERE p.CategoryID=c.CategoryID
wrong: SELECT p.ProductID,p.ProductName,c.CategoryName FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.ProductID=c.CategoryID

reference: SELECT CategoryID,COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE CategoryID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CategoryID HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
alternative: SELECT CategoryID,n FROM (SELECT CategoryID,COUNT(*) n FROM products WHERE CategoryID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CategoryID) g WHERE n>=2
wrong: SELECT CategoryID,COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE CategoryID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CategoryID HAVING COUNT(*)>2

reference: SELECT ProductID,SUM(Quantity) FROM order_details GROUP BY ProductID HAVING SUM(Quantity)>=10
alternative: SELECT ProductID,n FROM (SELECT ProductID,SUM(Quantity) n FROM order_details GROUP BY ProductID) q WHERE n>=10
wrong: SELECT ProductID,SUM(Quantity) FROM order_details GROUP BY ProductID HAVING SUM(Quantity)>10

reference: SELECT ProductID,UnitPrice FROM products WHERE UnitPrice>(SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM products)
alternative: WITH a AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) v FROM products) SELECT p.ProductID,p.UnitPrice FROM products p CROSS JOIN a WHERE p.UnitPrice>a.v
wrong: SELECT ProductID,UnitPrice FROM products WHERE UnitPrice>=(SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM products)

reference: SELECT c.CustomerID,COUNT(o.OrderID) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID
alternative: SELECT c.CustomerID,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.CustomerID=c.CustomerID) FROM customers c
wrong: SELECT c.CustomerID,COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID

reference: SELECT ProductID,SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity*(1-Discount)) FROM order_details GROUP BY ProductID
alternative: WITH v AS (SELECT ProductID,UnitPrice*Quantity*(1-Discount) valore FROM order_details) SELECT ProductID,SUM(valore) FROM v GROUP BY ProductID
wrong: SELECT ProductID,SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity) FROM order_details GROUP BY ProductID

reference: SELECT p.ProductID FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_details d WHERE d.ProductID=p.ProductID)
alternative: SELECT ProductID FROM products EXCEPT SELECT ProductID FROM order_details
